name: Titus
tagline: Good works that adorn the gospel
author: The apostle Paul.
date: Usually dated in the early to mid-60s AD.
setting: Written to Titus on the island of Crete.
theme: The grace of God leads to godly living.

outline.label: Older men and women, younger men, and slaves
The grace of God has appeared
Saved not by works but by mercy

christInBook: Paul says that Christ Jesus gave himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for himself a people for his own possession (2:14). Our hope is the appearing of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ.
howToRead: Titus is a short letter about how sound doctrine leads to good works. Notice the repeated call to “good works” and to a life that adorns the gospel.
